name: Avoid rivaroxaban with phenytoin
actions: Avoid concomitant rivaroxaban and phenytoin as directed in the rivaroxaban label.

rationale: The rivaroxaban label lists phenytoin among combined P-gp and strong CYP3A4 inducers that reduce rivaroxaban exposure.

explanation_template: Phenytoin can lower rivaroxaban exposure through combined CYP3A4 and P-gp induction. The rivaroxaban label says to avoid this combination.

references.citation: Avoid rivaroxaban with combined P-gp and strong CYP3A4 inducers, including phenytoin.
